Class Lane

java.lang.Object
Lane
public class Lane extends Object
Represents a single lane within a road edge in the traffic network.

A lane is a traffic flow channel within an edge. Each lane has its own:

  • Unique identifier from SUMO (e.g., "edge1_0")
  • Width (3.2 meters as default in SUMO)
  • Perpendicular offset from the edge centerline
  • Geometry calculated from parent edge endpoints

Lanes support:

  • Hit detection for user interaction (clicking to select)
  • Visual highlighting during route selection
  • Proper clipping at junction boundaries

    • Lane

      public Lane(String id, Edge parentEdge, double width, int index, double offsetFromCenter)
      Constructs a new lane with the specified properties.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique SUMO lane identifier (e.g., "edge1_0")
      parentEdge - The edge containing this lane
      width - The lane width in meters (typically 3.2m)
      index - The 0-based index of this lane within the parent edge
      offsetFromCenter - The perpendicular distance from the edge centerline in meters
